A state machine describes the present operating state, the outputs associated with that state, and the conditions that permit a transition.

| State | Outputs | Transition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| idle | motor off | start and guards safe |
| run | motor command active | stop, limit, or timer done |
| complete | complete indicator | reset |
| fault | outputs safe | fault cleared and reset approved |

## Design choices

- Define the initial state.
- Define every input condition once.
- Include timers where time changes behaviour.
- Provide reset and fault states.
- Decide how stop and safety inputs affect every state.

Suitable examples include an elevator, vending machine, traffic light, game, or miniature conveyor.
